metadata.title: Autodesk Inventor Drawing Operations — 2D Drawing Output Environment
metadata.description: Parameter catalog for the Inventor Drawing environment (.idw / .dwg) — the 2D output document type that consumes 3D parts/assemblies/weldments and emits sheets with views, dimensions, tables, and annotations for shop-floor delivery. Inventor drawings are document-level: a DrawingDocument owns one or more Sheets, each Sheet owns DrawingViews (Base / Projected / Section / Detail / Auxiliary / Break / Crop), DrawingDimensions (General / Baseline / Ordinate), tables (HoleTables / BendTables / PartsLists / RevisionTables), and annotations (GeneralNotes / SurfaceTextureSymbols / FeatureControlFrames). Catalog covers 19 operations: sheet management, the 7 view-creation operations, the 3 dimension styles, the 3 table types, 3 annotation symbol families, plus title-block + revision table management. Bindings reference real DrawingDocument / Sheet / DrawingView COM API. Drawing standards (ANSI / ISO / DIN / JIS / GB) carry through to symbol notation, dimension precision, projection method (1st-angle vs 3rd-angle), and table conventions.
metadata.source: Autodesk Inventor 2025 Help — Drawing Manager Reference; Inventor API Reference — Drawing namespace (DrawingDocument, Sheet, DrawingViews.AddBaseView / AddProjectedView / AddSectionView / AddDetailView / AddAuxiliaryView / AddBreakView / AddCropView, GeneralDimensions.Add, BaselineDimensionSets.Add, OrdinateDimensionSets.Add, HoleTables.Add, BendTables.Add, PartsLists.Add, GeneralNotes.Add, SurfaceTextureSymbols.Add, FeatureControlFrames.Add, RevisionTables.Add, TitleBlock); Drafting Standards: ANSI Y14.5 / ISO 1101 / ASME Y14.36 / ISO 1302

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across Inventor Drawing features. Most ops carry a Selection / Display / Style / Filter / Output tab structure mirroring the Inventor drawing-side dialogs.

SHEET.description: Add or configure a drawing sheet. Sheet format selects from ANSI A..E or ISO A0..A4 (or custom width/height); orientation is portrait/landscape; scale is the default scale applied to subsequent views unless overridden. Title block reference points at a reusable title block defined in the drawing template — overrides happen via the TITLE_BLOCK operation.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: Default sheet scale (e.g., '1:1', '1:2', '2:1', '1/4:1'); applied to views that do not override

parameters.name: Title Block Reference
parameters.description: Title block sketched-symbol name (must exist in drawing template)

BASE_VIEW.description: Primary view orientation derived from a 3D source document (.ipt / .iam / .iwm). Drives all subsequent projected / section / detail / break views as their parent. Style selects the rendering mode: hidden line (default for production), shaded for visualization, wireframe for clarity, hidden-line-removed for clean prints. Drawing standard inherits from sheet but can override per-view for mixed-standard drawings.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: View scale (e.g., '1:1', '1:2'); blank inherits sheet default

parameters.name: Show Hidden Lines
parameters.description: Show occluded edges as dashed lines

PROJECTED_VIEW.description: Orthographic projection from an existing parent view. Inventor automatically positions per the projection method (1st-angle European places below; 3rd-angle American places above for a top-projection). Inherits style + scale + display settings from parent unless explicitly overridden, ensuring drawing consistency. Diagonal projections produce isometric views.

parameters.name: Inherit Style
parameters.description: Inherit parent view's style + display settings

parameters.name: Inherit Scale
parameters.description: Inherit parent view's scale (false = use sheet default)

SECTION_VIEW.description: Section through a parent view along a section line. Section type selects geometry: Full (single line, full pass), Half (one side fully sectioned, other untouched), Aligned (multi-segment line preserving angular alignment), Offset (multi-segment line with rectangular jogs to capture multiple features). Hatch pattern + scale + angle apply per drawing standard's defaults but can override. Exclude Parts removes specific assembly parts from the cut to keep them whole (e.g., shafts, fasteners).

parameters.name: Section Line
parameters.description: Sketched section line on parent view

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: Depth of cut from section line (0 = through-all)

parameters.name: Slice
parameters.description: Show only the section slice (no material behind)

parameters.name: Show Section Cut
parameters.description: Show the cutting plane indicator on parent view

parameters.name: Exclude Parts
parameters.description: Assembly components to keep whole (skip cutting). Common for shafts / fasteners / standard hardware

DETAIL_VIEW.description: Magnified detail of a small region in a parent view. Boundary shape selects the detail-area outline (Circular = standard ANSI detail bubble, Rectangular = ISO-style box, Sketched = custom region). Connection style controls how the detail relates back to the parent: smooth (no connector), jagged (broken outline), connected (leader from boundary to detail). Magnification multiplies parent view's scale.

parameters.name: Parent View
parameters.description: View containing the region to detail

parameters.name: Display Full Boundary
parameters.description: Render the full circle/rectangle on detail view

parameters.name: Smooth Boundary
parameters.description: Smooth transitions where the detail crops geometry

AUXILIARY_VIEW.description: Projected view normal to a selected non-orthogonal edge or face on the parent view. Used for visualizing inclined features (oblique flanges, mating faces) at true size. Auto-cropping limits the view to a rectangular boundary perpendicular to the auxiliary direction.

parameters.name: Parent View
parameters.description: Source view containing the auxiliary edge

parameters.name: Auxiliary Edge
parameters.description: Edge or face the auxiliary view is normal to

parameters.name: Display Cropped
parameters.description: Crop view to auxiliary boundary only

BREAK_VIEW.description: Break-out for long parts (typically tubular / shaft / profile members). Reduces sheet space by removing a midspan slice; the break style determines visual treatment (Rectangular = simple step lines per ANSI; Structural = jagged lines for steel / extrusions; Curved = sinusoidal for shafts / round stock). Number of Symbols repeats the break visualization for very long parts.

parameters.name: Number of Symbols
parameters.description: Repeat count for very long parts

parameters.name: Display Break Lines
parameters.description: Show the break-line symbols on the view

CROP_VIEW.description: Crop an existing view to a sketched boundary. Differs from Detail in that no magnification occurs and no parent/child relation is created — used for trimming oversized views to fit. Cut-Through controls whether geometry behind the crop boundary is fully removed (true) or shown as ghost lines (false).

parameters.name: Crop Boundary Sketch
parameters.description: Closed sketch on the view defining the crop boundary

parameters.name: Cut Through
parameters.description: Fully remove cropped geometry vs ghost

DIMENSION.description: General dimension that auto-classifies type from the selection: Linear (point-to-point distance), Aligned (point-to-line at angle), Angular (between two lines), Radial (radius), Diametric (diameter), Arc Length (along arc curvature), Chamfer (chamfer dimension with angle + length). Tolerance type is the canonical ASME Y14.5 / ISO 14405 set. Inspection Dimension flag wraps the dimension value in an oval per ASME Y14.5 inspection convention.

parameters.name: Geometry References
parameters.description: Edges / points / arcs to dimension (cardinality depends on Type)

parameters.name: Dual Dimension
parameters.description: Show alternate-units dual dimension below primary

parameters.name: Leader Style
parameters.description: Optional leader from dimension to feature

parameters.name: Text Override
parameters.description: Override displayed value (rarely used; breaks driving relationship)

parameters.name: Inspection Dimension
parameters.description: Wrap value in oval per ASME Y14.5 inspection convention

BASELINE_DIMENSION.description: Baseline-dimension set: chained linear dimensions all measured from a single datum. Auto-distributes spacing between dimension lines to avoid overlap. Common on parts with multiple holes / slots referenced from a single edge.

parameters.name: Geometry
parameters.description: Set of points / edges to dimension

parameters.name: Datum Reference
parameters.description: Baseline edge / point all dimensions originate from

parameters.name: Text Override
parameters.description: Override displayed value on selected dimension(s)

ORDINATE_DIMENSION.description: Ordinate (datum-referenced) dimension set per ASME Y14.5: distance from origin along an axis, displayed as plain text without dimension lines. Used for high-precision parts where many features reference a single 0,0 origin (common on machined plates / panels). Aligned style places text along the leader; With Leader places text remote with leader callout.

parameters.name: Origin Reference
parameters.description: Origin point (0,0) for the ordinate set

parameters.name: Geometry Set
parameters.description: Points / edges to dimension from origin

HOLE_TABLE.description: Tabulated hole locations + sizes referenced to a datum origin. Hole filter selects which feature types appear (Through Holes / Tapped / Counterbored / All). Tag Style controls hole identifier format (A1 / A1-A5 group / numeric); Roll Up Tags merges identical holes into a single row with quantity. Common for machined plates with many bolt holes.

parameters.name: View
parameters.description: View on which the table operates

parameters.name: Group Identical Holes
parameters.description: Merge same-spec holes into single tag with QTY

parameters.name: Header Style
parameters.description: Header row style override (defaults to drawing standard)

BEND_TABLE.description: Sheet metal bend table emitted from a flat-pattern view. Lists each bend's identifier + angle + direction + radius for shop-floor brake operation. Callout Style picks identifier convention (A/B/C alphabetic, B1 numeric-first, B-1 hyphenated-numeric). Direction symbols (U/D up/down arrows) signal press-brake direction. Sort by tag alphabetical or by physical ordering on the part.

parameters.name: Flat Pattern View
parameters.description: Sheet metal flat pattern view (must be a flat pattern, not folded)

parameters.name: Show Direction Symbols
parameters.description: Show up/down direction next to bend angle

PARTS_LIST.description: Assembly Bill of Materials table. BOM View selects the structural depth: Structured (full hierarchy with sub-assemblies expanded), Parts Only (flattened to leaf parts), Compact (top-level only with Quantity Per). Item Filter excludes/includes specific BOM categories (Standard Hardware / Inseparable assemblies / etc.). Custom Columns extends the default ITEM/QTY/PART NUMBER/DESCRIPTION with user-defined columns from iProperties.

parameters.name: View Reference
parameters.description: Drawing view whose source assembly the BOM is generated from

parameters.name: Heading Style
parameters.description: Heading style override (defaults to drawing standard)

parameters.name: Wrap Text
parameters.description: Wrap long descriptions to multiple lines

NOTE_LEADER.description: Free-text note with optional leader pointing at a feature. Field Reference embeds dynamic values (parameters / iProperties / custom properties) that update with the source — common for tying note text to a parameter so dimension changes propagate to text. Background Mask draws a rectangle behind text to obscure underlying geometry.

parameters.name: Attachment Point
parameters.description: Position on sheet (or feature for leader)

parameters.name: Font Override
parameters.description: Font family override (defaults to drawing standard)

parameters.name: Field Reference
parameters.description: Field name to embed dynamic value (e.g., '<DIM_VALUE>', '<PARTNUMBER>')

parameters.name: Background Mask
parameters.description: Draw rectangle behind text to mask geometry

SURFACE_TEXTURE.description: Surface texture symbol per ASME Y14.36 (US) or ISO 1302. Symbol Type selects the basic outline (Basic = open V, Material Removal Required = V with bar, Material Removal Prohibited = V with circle, Any Process = V no qualifier). Roughness values (Ra, Rz, Rmax) populate the symbol; sampling length is the cutoff length for measurement. Lay Direction symbol denotes machining direction (parallel ‖, perpendicular ⊥, crossed ✕, multidirectional M, circular C, radial R, particulate P).

parameters.name: All Around
parameters.description: Apply to all surfaces (circle on symbol)

GDT_FRAME.description: Geometric tolerance frame per ASME Y14.5 / ISO 1101. Symbol selects from 16 geometric characteristics: form (flatness, straightness, circularity, cylindricity), profile (line, surface), orientation (angularity, perpendicularity, parallelism), location (position, concentricity, symmetry), runout (circular, total). Modifier flags add MMC (Maximum Material Condition) / LMC / RFS / Free State / Tangent Plane. Composite frame supports two-tier tolerance (top tier larger pattern locating, bottom tier tighter feature-relating).

parameters.name: Composite Frame Second Tier
parameters.description: Second-tier tolerance value for composite frames (blank = single-tier)

parameters.name: All Around
parameters.description: Apply tolerance around full perimeter (circle on leader)

TITLE_BLOCK.description: Title block override on a sheet. Inventor title blocks are reusable sketched symbols stored in the drawing template; this operation overrides specific custom-field values per-sheet (Drawn By, Approval Date, etc.) without forking the template. Custom Field Overrides accepts a JSON dictionary of field-name → value pairs.

parameters.name: Reference Style
parameters.description: Title block sketched-symbol name (must exist in template)

parameters.name: Custom Field Overrides
parameters.description: JSON dictionary of additional field overrides (e.g., '{"Project":"FRAME-A","Rev":"B"}')

REVISION_TABLE.description: Revision history table on a sheet. Tracks per-row revision letter / number, description, ECO reference, date, approver. Auto-Renumber updates revision letters as rows are added (A → B → C ...). Sort Direction controls whether newest revisions appear at top (descending) or bottom (ascending). Number Format selects letters (A/B/C..., skipping I/O/Q/S/X/Z per ASME Y14.35) or numbers (1/2/3...).

parameters.name: Auto-Renumber
parameters.description: Auto-update revision letters/numbers when rows are added
